bugs.description: Handshake race: an early new AWVALID aborts a pending response, deasserting BVALID before BREADY (violates the VALID-stable rule).
AND/OR typo in the request-completion condition: a response is issued after only one of the AW/W beats (response without a complete request).

description: AXI4-Lite write-channel slave skeleton; asserts no response without a complete request, BVALID stability until BREADY, and no beat acceptance during a pending response.
